covers: A single-fix tutorial with a diagnosis attached — tests whether the script keeps the diagnosis and the fix distinct instead of merging them into advice.
idea: Teach the fix for a grip that gives out before the back does on rows and pulls. Hook the thumb around the bar instead of tucking it, drop the weight a notch, and hold the last rep at the top for a slow count. Most people are not weak, they are just letting go early.

hooks.text: Your hands quit before your back does. Every time.
hooks.rationale: Names the frustration in the words the viewer would use themselves.

hooks.text: You're not weak. You're letting go early.
hooks.rationale: Contradicts the self-diagnosis the viewer arrived with.

hooks.text: There's one thing you do with your thumb that costs you the whole set.
hooks.rationale: Opens the gap on the fix without giving it away.

hooks.text: Fix your grip and your rows get better without adding a kilo.
hooks.rationale: The strongest true version of the idea, stated flat.

sections.text: Your hands quit before your back does.
Every row, every pull, same story. You put the bar down and your back still has plenty left in it.

Hook the thumb around the bar instead of tucking it behind your fingers. Then drop the weight a notch, because you are not chasing the number today. On the last rep, hold at the top for a slow count and let your hands find out that this is survivable. Nobody is watching you shake.
Give it a few weeks and your grip stops being the thing that ends the set. Then you find out what your back can actually do.
Next back day, thumb around the bar. Tell me whether the last set feels different.

claims.text: The thumb goes around the bar rather than tucked.
claims.grounded_in: Hook the thumb around the bar instead of tucking it

claims.text: Grip failure is usually letting go early, not weakness.
claims.grounded_in: Most people are not weak, they are just letting go early

voice_fidelity.evidence: "Nobody is watching you shake" lands a signature phrase naturally, though the payoff runs longer than the profile's one-line close.

hook_distinctiveness.evidence: The frustration, the reframe, the withheld fix and the flat claim each start a different video.

script_completeness.evidence: Diagnosis, fix and one concrete ask; nothing is left for the creator to write.

instruction_adherence.evidence: The thumb, the weight drop and the slow count all come from the idea, and no equipment or study is invented.
